content.value_statement: TUnit and Playwright test commands can be easy to misapply in .NET projects. This skill guides agents to run the correct project, filters, reports, and parallel settings.
actual_capabilities: Runs the full TUnit Playwright suite through the configured .NET project.
Applies limited parallelism settings for sequential or controlled test runs.
Builds tree node filters by class, exact test name, wildcard, or namespace.
Requests console detail output or TRX reports for test results.
Explains the project files that manage retries, setup, server readiness, and timeouts.
limitations: Assumes the SummitUI.Tests.Playwright project layout exists in the repository.
Does not install the .NET SDK, Playwright browsers, or project dependencies.
Does not repair failing tests without a separate debugging task.
Long browser test runs may depend on local machine resources.

use_cases.title: Run the Browser Test Suite
use_cases.description: Execute the full TUnit Playwright suite and report pass or fail status with useful output.

use_cases.title: Target a Failing Test Area
use_cases.description: Use tree node filters to focus on a class, test name, wildcard pattern, or namespace.

use_cases.title: Collect Test Reports
use_cases.description: Generate detailed console output or TRX reports for review in development workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Run All Tests
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a complete suite check.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the full TUnit Playwright test suite and summarize the result.

prompt_templates.title: Run Tests Sequentially
prompt_templates.scenario: Limit resource use on a local machine.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the TUnit Playwright tests with one test at a time and report any failures.

prompt_templates.title: Filter by Class
prompt_templates.scenario: Focus on a known test class.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run only the TUnit Playwright tests for the named class and show the failing test names.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Reported Run
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced run for diagnostics or build evidence.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the focused TUnit Playwright tests with detailed output and a report suitable for review.

output_examples.output: The skill selects the configured TUnit Playwright project, runs the suite, and summarizes passed, failed, and skipped tests.
The skill applies a focused tree node filter, executes matching tests, and reports any failing test names.

output_examples.input: Generate a test report for release review.
output_examples.output: The skill requests report output, runs the selected tests, and identifies where the generated results should be reviewed.

best_practices: Start with limited parallelism when diagnosing browser test failures.
Use class or test name filters before rerunning a large suite.
Ask for report output when results must be shared with a team.
anti_patterns: Do not use broad wildcard filters when a single failing test is known.
Do not assume report files exist unless the run requested report output.
Do not increase parallelism during flaky browser test investigation.

faq.question: What does this skill run?
faq.answer: It runs the SummitUI TUnit Playwright test project through the .NET runner.

faq.question: Can it run one test class?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents tree node filters for class, test name, wildcard, and namespace selection.

faq.question: Does it support sequential runs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes limited parallelism guidance for one test at a time.

faq.question: Can it create test reports?
faq.answer: Yes. It can request detailed console output or TRX report generation.

faq.question: Does it install dependencies?
faq.answer: No. The repository must already have required .NET and Playwright dependencies available.

faq.question: Is this limited to one repository layout?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions assume the SummitUI.Tests.Playwright project path and related setup files.
